description: USE THIS to check whether a top-level domain is real before trusting a domain or link — do NOT guess whether a TLD like .zip, .corp, .crypto or .web exists. Checks the suffix against the authoritative IANA root-zone list (kept current). Returns valid:false for TLDs that are not actually delegated.

tld.description: The TLD to check, with or without a leading dot (e.g. 'zip' or '.zip').

name: validate_tld
